blocks.text: (After subduing and capturing Samana) Banda made another resolution, That he should plunder Wazir Khan's Sirhind after assembling all his forces. Lest the Majhail Singhs should remain deprived of the spoils of war, Since they would be joining him after travelling a lot of distance. (1)
lines: (After subduing and capturing Samana) Banda made another resolution,
That he should plunder Wazir Khan's Sirhind after assembling all his forces.
Lest the Majhail Singhs should remain deprived of the spoils of war,
Since they would be joining him after travelling a lot of distance.

blocks.text: Before that he should devastate the old enemies of the Panth at Kunjpura2, A town, inhabited by the Muslims, on the western bank of the Yamuna.
By the time he conquered and captured that Muslim town, The Majhail Singhs would also arrive and join his forces. (2)
lines: By the time he conquered and captured that Muslim town,
The Majhail Singhs would also arrive and join his forces.

blocks.text: Banda Singh had also heard about the town of Sadhaura, Where lived a Muslim Pir, claiming to possess power of miracles. Banda Singh threatened to burn this Pir's own body into fire, Whose Shadow was reported to make a dead body immune to fire. (3)
lines: Banda Singh had also heard about the town of Sadhaura,
Where lived a Muslim Pir, claiming to possess power of miracles.
Banda Singh threatened to burn this Pir's own body into fire,
Whose Shadow was reported to make a dead body immune to fire.

blocks.text: Banda Singh declared that Pir's body would burn in fire, As easily as a ball of soft cotton burns in a fire. His miraculous powers would not be able to protect him, As fire would engulf his body into its flames. (4)
lines: Banda Singh declared that Pir's body would burn in fire,
As easily as a ball of soft cotton burns in a fire.
His miraculous powers would not be able to protect him,
As fire would engulf his body into its flames.

blocks.text: Banda Singh would prove that he wielded greater miraculous powers, By burning his body and reducing it to the ashes. After making this declaration Banda Singh launched his attack, And got the city of Sadhaura plundered by the Khalsa forces. (5)
lines: Banda Singh would prove that he wielded greater miraculous powers,
By burning his body and reducing it to the ashes.
After making this declaration Banda Singh launched his attack,
And got the city of Sadhaura plundered by the Khalsa forces.

blocks.text: Whereas the Hindu households were ordered to be protected, Whole Muslim population was ordered to be slaughtered. While inhabitants wearing a tuft of hair on their heads were spared, All others were mercilessly butchered and slaughtered by the Singhs. (6)
lines: Whereas the Hindu households were ordered to be protected,
Whole Muslim population was ordered to be slaughtered.
While inhabitants wearing a tuft of hair on their heads were spared,
All others were mercilessly butchered and slaughtered by the Singhs.

blocks.text: The Muslim inhabitants who had taken refuge in Hindu households, Were also not harmed by the plundering Khalsa forces. All others who happened to fall into their hands, Were brutally murdered and killed by the enraged Singhs. (7)
lines: The Muslim inhabitants who had taken refuge in Hindu households,
Were also not harmed by the plundering Khalsa forces.
All others who happened to fall into their hands,
Were brutally murdered and killed by the enraged Singhs.

blocks.text: The coffin with the dead body of the Pir had been kept on a raised platform, While an approach road (to the Hindu cremation ground) passed underneath. Fire would refuse to burn a dead body in its raging flames, If it happened to come under the shadow of Pir's coffin. (8)
lines: The coffin with the dead body of the Pir had been kept on a raised platform,
While an approach road (to the Hindu cremation ground) passed underneath.
Fire would refuse to burn a dead body in its raging flames,
If it happened to come under the shadow of Pir's coffin.

blocks.text: Such an affected body, irrespective of its being that of a Hindu or Muslim, Had to be perforce burried in the earth like that of a Muslim. Banda Singh ordered the Pir's dead body to be brought down, And put into raging fire after pulling it out of the coffin. (9)
lines: Such an affected body, irrespective of its being that of a Hindu or Muslim,
Had to be perforce burried in the earth like that of a Muslim.
Banda Singh ordered the Pir's dead body to be brought down,
And put into raging fire after pulling it out of the coffin.

blocks.text: It caught fire as quickly as butter oil caught fire at the touch of a spark, And exploded as if some one had ignited a heap of explosives. It was reduced to ashes with the first touch of fire, And the news of burning a Muslim's dead body spread upto Mecca Madina. (10)
lines: It caught fire as quickly as butter oil caught fire at the touch of a spark,
And exploded as if some one had ignited a heap of explosives.
It was reduced to ashes with the first touch of fire,
And the news of burning a Muslim's dead body spread upto Mecca Madina.

blocks.text: Then Banda Singh made a sensational disclosure about his powers, How he had acquired the knowledge of Fire Mantra from Aloonia Sidh3 . The Muslim Pir had mastered only one -fourth of that spell, With which he could obstruct fire from burning a dead body. (11)
